Intermittent stop-and-go scheme will be implemented along Roxas Boulevard southbound from Katigbak Drive to South Road, tomorrow, June 10, from 7am to 11am, to give way to the rehearsal of uniformed personnel from the Philippine National Police, Armed Forces of the Philippines, Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine Coast Guard, and Bureau of Jail Management and Penology, in preparation for the 127th Philippine Independence Day celebration on June 12.

Trucks going northbound will be diverted to Quirino Avenue, while those going southbound will be rerouted to Capulong Street and Anda Circle.

Motorists are advised to use alternate routes to avoid inconvenience.
